v2_findings.title: Auto — Named Driver Exclusion (Malina Trujillo)
v2_findings.content:
[Bad] Auto — Named Driver Exclusion (Malina Trujillo)
Risk Score: 6/25

What this means:
There's a person named Malina Trujillo on your policy who's specifically excluded. If they get behind the wheel of a company car — even in an emergency — your auto policy won't cover the accident. You need to make sure this person never has access to a company vehicle, and HR/dispatch needs to know.

Recommendation:
Verify operational controls preventing this individual from operating company vehicles. Document in HR records. Consider whether the underlying cause (likely MVR issue) has been resolved and the exclu

v2_findings.title: Auto — Hired & Non-Owned Auto Coverage
v2_findings.content:
[Good] Auto — Hired & Non-Owned Auto Coverage

What this means:
Hired and non-owned auto coverage is in place — meaning when employees rent cars for travel or use personal vehicles for business, your auto policy responds. Good.

Recommendation:
Maintain. Consider increasing if employee count grows.

v2_findings.content:
[Bad] Auto — Care, Custody, or Control Exclusion (Ballot Transit)
Risk Score: 9/25

What this means:
If your truck rolls over and ballots are destroyed mid-transit, your auto policy doesn't pay because the cargo is in your care, custody, and control.
